name: What preparation do I need to do before my new flooring is installed?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before my new flooring is installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation, you'll need to clear the room of furniture, appliances, and personal belongings. We can assist with furniture moving for an additional fee if requested. Ensure any existing flooring is removed, though we can also handle demolition as part of our service. The subfloor must be clean, dry, and level for proper installation. Addressing any moisture issues or structural concerns beforehand is crucial for the longevity and performance of your new floor. We will advise on specific preparations during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the room of items and ensure the subfloor is clean, dry, and level. We can assist with furniture moving and old flooring removal.
